name: Countess Rebecca
source:
Earl of Mount Bell, Rebecca is the last of her line. A close childhood friend of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. A series of mysterious accidents have decimated the ranks of the House of Gaor and her family. Rebecca never expected to rule. While no more than close friends, she has long sort to experience the MC sexually to satisfy her curiosity about her friend.

[In game description]
